Airbnb Careers

Product Manager, Incubations

About the role

Responsibilities include incubating new lines of business. You will work with design and engineering partners to take early concepts to market.

This role can be based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY, with in-person collaboration 3 days per week.

The base pay range for this position is $220,000 - $275,000 annually.

Offers may also include an incentive bonus, and you may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

We are looking for experience shipping zero-to-one products.
